title: One perception core. A whole growing season.
lead: QUERRA is building an operator-guided scouting and evidence application for cereal fields. It takes RGB photographs, runs GPU inference on the device and records GPS and time where available. Every result shows its uncertainty, goes through human review and leaves as a traceable export.
heroNote: Below: the actual prototype, then the field units we plan to validate. After the funded TRL7 boundary, the platforms are research concepts.

device.alt: Photograph of the QUERRA prototype on a workbench: a black aluminium enclosure with a vent grille, a green-ringed power button, a camera bracket holding a two-lens camera board with an orange ribbon cable, and two black antennas.
device.caption: Photograph of the actual prototype, November 2026. All image metadata, including location, was removed before publication.
